title: US airline checked-bag fee revenue

source.name: Schedule P-1.2, Air Carrier Financial Reports
source.publisher: Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS), U.S. DOT

notes: Checked-bag fees were introduced by US airlines starting in 2007-2008. BTS-reported bag fee revenue: $0.464B (2007), $3.4B (2010), $5.76B (2019, pre-pandemic record), $5.3B (2021), $6.7B (2022), $7.1B (2023).
